run.machines: Lambda Cloud us-east-1: m1-m4 NVIDIA A10 24 GB ($1.29/h each), m5 A100 SXM4 40 GB ($1.99/h); m3, m4 for the failure and identical-machines tests only; Ubuntu 22.04; one private network. Run 4's Quadro RTX 6000 and RTX A6000 were out of capacity
run.ollama: 0.40.16 with OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=4 and OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=4096 on every machine (Ollama's VRAM-based default context would have given the A100 32768 and the A10s 4096)
run.workload: about 1,250 prompt and 200 completion tokens per chat request
run.telemetry: off on every router and node
run.harness: scripts/benchmark.py at b6fdda9 (per-request records, in-band errors counted as failures, rates over the load phase)

failure.what: 4 machines, 8 concurrent qwen3-coder:30b for 240 s, 3 repetitions; a script on the controlling laptop waited for the run's start line on the router machine, then stopped Ollama on m3 about 60 s later and, 90 s after that, killed herd-node with -9 and stopped Ollama on m4 (kill times logged on the machines, to the millisecond)

events.what: killed herd-node -9 and stopped Ollama on m4 (machine gone)
killed herd-node -9 and stopped Ollama on m4 (machine gone)
killed herd-node -9 and stopped Ollama on m4 (machine gone)

identical_machines.what: one model on four identical machines, 8 concurrent qwen3-coder:30b, 120 s, 3 repetitions per front door, alternating Herd and HAProxy

mixed_fleet.what: m1, m2 (A10 24 GB) and m5 (A100 40 GB); qwen3-coder:30b, qwen2.5:14b-instruct-q8_0, phi4:14b-q8_0 and qwen2.5:32b-instruct-q6_K (30 GB loaded, only m5 has it and can hold it), model chosen at random per request, open loop at 0.25 requests/s for 180 s, client timeout 300 s; start state m1 coder, m2 qwen2.5:14b, m5 the 32b; repetitions 1-3 are seeds 7, 11, 13, the same seeds for every front door

one_large_vs_two_small.what: one A100 SXM4 40 GB ($1.99/h) against two A10 24 GB ($2.58/h), each behind its own router; mix = qwen3-coder:30b, qwen3.5:9b and nomic-embed-text, 4 workers each, 180 s; 3 repetitions

vision.what: qwen3-coder:30b, nomic-embed-text and moondream (an image question per request), 4 workers each, 180 s; one A10 with all three loaded, against m1, m2 and m5; 3 repetitions
